name: Connect your wallet to verify assets — crypto-drain pretext
description: A crypto approach moves the target off-platform, sends them to a fake verification website, and asks them to connect their wallet to 'verify assets'. Connecting the wallet and approving a permission is what drains it. The signal is the wallet-connect request combined with a verification pretext and an off-platform or fake-site vector.

source_references.document_ref: Advisory TAU-ADV-013 — Trust Wallet crypto scams (original PDF unavailable)

manual_retrieval.official_alternate_source: CyberDost / I4C, Ministry of Home Affairs — https://www.t.me/s/cyberdosti4c
manual_retrieval.notes: Original advisory PDF still unavailable (SRC-024 stays RETRIEVAL_FAILED). The official I4C CyberDost channel post matches the P2P contact -> WhatsApp/Telegram handoff -> fake verification site -> wallet connection -> permission -> fund transfer chain. OFFICIAL_ALTERNATE caps this rule at PARTIAL (ADR-0015).

explanation.plain: You were asked to connect your crypto wallet to a website to 'verify' your assets. Connecting your wallet and approving the request can let a scammer move your funds out. Legitimate verification never needs you to connect your wallet to an unfamiliar site.
explanation.technical: WALLET_CONNECT_REQUEST (device-action) + a verification pretext or fake verification site + an off-platform/link vector. Matches the I4C CyberDost Trust Wallet chain.
verification_steps: Never connect your wallet to a site you reached from an unsolicited message.
Check the domain carefully; verification of holdings never requires a wallet connection.
explanation.why_confidence_limited: Evidence is an official I4C CyberDost channel post (OFFICIAL_ALTERNATE), not the formal advisory PDF, which remains unreachable. The rule is capped at PARTIAL and needs a stronger indicator combination to reach the same risk band as a fully-primary rule.

provenance.notes: UNSUPPORTED at Phase 1 (SRC-024 unreachable, G-01). Rebound to the official CyberDost/I4C post (MR-EVID-010) under DEC-006 / ADR-0015; verdict PARTIAL (capped), published with the seven official-alternate conditions recorded.
